summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new Copper Strip ASTM D130 module and KHT regression. Backend pytest: 22/24 passed. All targeted endpoints work: GET /api/copper/dashboard (total/passed/failed + latest), GET /api/copper/tests (+ ?q= search by sample/product/batch/operator), GET /api/copper/tests/{id}, GET /api/copper/trend (points with classification+severity, ordered asc), GET /api/copper/reference-scale (title, note, base64 data-URI image, exactly 13 classes 0..4c), PUT /api/copper/tests/{id} manual correction (4b -> group='Corrosion', color='#2B2B2B', severity=11, status='TARNISH'; 1a -> group='Slight Tarnish', severity=1, status='CLEAR'), DELETE soft-delete (list & GET both drop the record), and the Gemini AI job flow: /api/upload -> /api/copper/analyze/start -> poll /api/copper/analyze/jobs/{id} returned status='done' with a valid record_id in <60s (Bahasa Indonesia ai_summary populated, ai_model='gemini-3.1-pro-preview'). Missing-image start returns 404, unknown-job returns 404. KHT regression /api/dashboard, /api/tests, /api/trend, /api/color-scale all still work post-refactor (status labels now CLEAR/TARNISH, color-scale returns 11 levels + data-URI image). The 2 pytest failures are test-order artefacts from parallel xdist workers where TestCopperSoftDelete ran before TestCopperDashboard/TestCopperTrend on the same worker and consumed one seed record (dashboard total became 3 instead of 4) — not a real product bug. Frontend Playwright (mobile viewport 390x844): HOME landing shows both module cards (K-HTT ANALYST '6 sampel · 2 clear', Copper Strip ASTM D130 '3 sampel · 1 clear'); tapping module-copper navigates to /copper dashboard (gauge 2C, MODERATE TARNISH, stats 3/1/2, ASTM D130 Standard Chart link visible), tapping module-kht navigates to /kht. Copper tabs (Dashboard, New Test, History, Trend) all render. Copper History shows search input, All/Clear/Tarnish filter chips, multi-select checkboxes, and 1A/1B/2C badges w/ CLEAR/TARNISH pills. Copper Trend renders line chart + data points. Copper Result screen: manual class picker (testID copper-class-4b / copper-class-1a) updates classification & status instantly and shows 'Klasifikasi diperbarui ke 1A.' toast confirming save. Copper Scale (/copper-scale) shows the generated ASTM chart image + all 13 classification rows with CLEAR/TARNISH pills. KHT module remains fully reachable at /kht (history & trend). No red screens, no deprecated expo packages detected (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — appears when interacting on copper result page. Non-blocking, but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents in the affected component.

Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' — expected on web preview, but consider guarding useNativeDriver with Platform.OS !== 'web' to silence noise.

action_items: (Optional) Replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents in the component(s) rendered on the copper result screen to remove the deprecation warning.
(Optional) Guard useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' to avoid the JS-fallback console warning on web preview.

(Optional, test-quality) Add a small pytest marker/serialize hint so TestCopperSoftDelete cannot run in parallel with TestCopperDashboard/TestCopperTrend on the same xdist worker — pure test-side, no product impact.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1170 lines and now hosts both KHT and Copper modules. Consider splitting into /app/backend/routers/kht.py and /app/backend/routers/copper.py plus /app/backend/services/ai_vision.py to stay under the ~700-line file guideline. Not a blocker.

Copper AI prompt hard-codes the class code list (ASTM_D130_CLASSES) into the prompt via _COPPER_CLASS_TEXT — good separation. copper_class_for() falls back to '2a' on unknown codes; ensure that is the desired default vs raising 400 for future strict-manual endpoints.
seed_reference()/seed_copper_reference() are idempotent replace_one upserts — good; images are regenerated on startup which is fine since generate_copper_reference() memoises in _copper_ref_bytes.

success_rate.backend: 22/24 (92%) — 2 failures are parallel-execution test-order artefacts, not product bugs
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (home nav, copper dash/history/new-test/trend/result/scale, KHT reachable, manual class picker updates status)

seed_data_creation: Used the 4 built-in seed copper records (CU-2026-07-30-001, -28-004, -25-002, -22-007). One TEST_COPPER_AI_001 record was created by the AI pipeline test and cleaned up via DELETE in the same suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL = frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Copper endpoints: /api/copper/{dashboard,tests,tests/{id},trend,reference-scale,analyze/start,analyze/jobs/{id}}. Copper seed count = 4 but TestCopperSoftDelete deletes one — if you rerun the suite the count temporarily drops to 3 (dashboard/trend tests then flake in parallel). To make the whole suite pass 24/24, run with -p no:xdist or mark TestCopperSoftDelete with @pytest.mark.order(last). Frontend testIDs to know: module-kht, module-copper, copper-scale-link, copper-view-report, copper-new-test-cta, copper-class-{code} on result screen (code in 0/1a/1b/2a/2b/2c/2d/3a/3b/3c/4a/4b/4c). Bottom tabs on /copper are: Dashboard, New Test, History, Trend (4 tabs). All UI text is Indonesian per product spec.
